scope: 139 completed original broad native scores plus only genuinely new complete precise scores present at snapshot
objective: equal six-case mean of actual goal-token P(user)
oracle_envelope_warning: Descriptive upper envelope over different measured templates; not the score of one universal template and not a bound on future search.
style_causal_warning: Near-budget rows generally vary delimiter style, tail length, repetition count, or native serialization together. Do not attribute these differences to style alone.

next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.direction: Cross exact repeated-prefix units with local boundary/tail styles at fixed repetition counts
next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.experiment: For semantic and word prefixes at best measured 8K/16K length, cross zero_width_name, right_gap, space_delimiters and plain Markdown user tails; preserve the complete goal and select only complete equal-six-case mean.
next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.reason: Existing word 1K versus 2K results change both length and tail style; semantic right_gap and zero_width_name favor different tasks. This isolates boundary sensitivity instead of assuming monotonic length.

next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.direction: Numerical local search around goal-side user introduction
next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.experiment: Hold the long repeated prefix fixed; coordinate-search the final 32–128 ordinary tokens preceding {goal}, the approximate delimiter whitespace, and short first-person/user header variants. Recombine banking-u10 and travel-u17 specialists as proposals, never as replacement fitness.
next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.reason: Best current mean is bottlenecked by banking-u10 and travel-u17. Their observed per-case envelope is also below0.90, so selecting existing per-task elites cannot solve the objective.

next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.direction: Optimize repetition allocation and ordering instead of only total length
next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.experiment: At fixed 8K/16K budgets search semantic:word:metadata mixtures 1:0:0,3:1:0,1:1:0,2:0:1 and block-versus-interleaved order; move the last 256–1024 repeated tokens adjacent to the user tail. Reuse all six complete model captures for each score.
next_directions_if_16k_scaling_misses_po.reason: Semantic repetition has controlled positive length evidence, while different families trade banking versus travel gains. Allocation/order provides new numerical degrees of freedom after total length saturates.
